answers.question: Did the vendor promise delivery by March 31?
answers.answer: Originally yes, but this was later changed. Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §2.1 says: "The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than March 31, 2026." This was later replaced by Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.1: "The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than May 15, 2026."

The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than May 15, 2026.

citations.quote: The Vendor delivered the Phase 1 System on May 22, 2026.

answers.question: How many days does the customer have to pay invoices?
answers.answer: Currently: Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.2 says: "The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt." This replaced the original wording in Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §3.2: "The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receipt."

citations.quote: The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt.
citations.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement

citations.quote: The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receipt.

answers.question: What happens if the vendor misses the delivery deadline?
answers.answer: Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §6.1 says: "If the Vendor fails to deliver the Phase 1 System by the date in clause 2.1, the Vendor shall pay liquidated damages of GBP 1,000 for each day of delay, up to a maximum of GBP 30,000."

citations.quote: If the Vendor fails to deliver the Phase 1 System by the date in clause 2.1, the Vendor shall pay liquidated damages of GBP 1,000 for each day of delay, up to a maximum of GBP 30,000.
Clause 6.1 does not apply where the delay is caused by the Customer's failure to comply with clause 2.3.

answers.question: Is customer data kept in the UK?
answers.answer: The documents disagree. Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §5.2 says: "The Vendor shall not transfer Customer data outside the United Kingdom without the Customer's prior written consent." However, Vendor Security Audit Report — Corvane Software Ltd. (v1.0), §2.2 says: "Data location: All Customer data is hosted in the vendor's Dublin, Ireland data centre." (Location differs: commitment refers to United Kingdom; other document says Ireland.)

citations.quote: The Vendor shall not transfer Customer data outside the United Kingdom without the Customer's prior written consent.
Data location: All Customer data is hosted in the vendor's Dublin, Ireland data centre.

answers.question: Which commitments changed in the amendment?
answers.answer:
4 commitment(s) changed:
- §2.1: "The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than March 31, 2026." → "The Vendor shall deliver the Phase 1 System no later than May 15, 2026." (Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.1)
- §3.2: "The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days of receipt." → "The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within 45 days of receipt." (Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.2)
- §5.3: "The Vendor shall notify the Customer of any personal data breach within 48 hours of becoming aware of it." → "The Vendor shall notify the Customer of any personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it." (Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.3)
- New §5.5: "The Vendor shall complete an independent penetration test of the Phase 1 System before go-live and share the summary report with the Customer." (Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement (v1.0), §1.4)
